owner: Hypercurve retained selected-point definitions and native point replay; Hypersolve owns common-field joins, polynomial evaluation and root selection. HyperBREP persists the shared planar definition.
domain: A finite nonzero univariate polynomial of arbitrary finite degree whose ascending coefficients are admitted source-bound rational point queries. Coefficients may use independent real-algebraic selections or existing supported symbolic values with exact decisions. A supplied open singleton isolator or exact represented root selects a point (root,0).
preserved: Original coefficient queries, source dependencies, denominator guards, root relation and selector. No mandatory primitive element or separately projected coordinate. Native exact replay revalidates sources and selection; root-count flags are never trusted.
